order: Fix a sharper edge on the stable-alias fix: when the alias a live checkout was created through is later removed, sweep-time path re-lookup falls back to the lexical alias spelling while git's own listed path stays canonical, causing the sweep to delete the live canonical checkout. Capture the canonical identity once at creation time, when every path component is guaranteed to exist, and have the live-set comparison always use that captured identity rather than a sweep-time re-lookup. Pin a regression for the alias-removal case. Separately, diagnose and fix an intermittent review-lane test failure: git holds a newly created worktree locked for the whole checkout while it is already visible in the list, so a kill during that window leaves it locked forever, and a single removal command cannot clear a locked worktree; make the terminate-signal branch wait out the registration window the same way the kill-signal branch already does.
claims: The canonical identity is now captured once at creation, when every path component is guaranteed to exist, and the live-set comparison always uses that captured value rather than a sweep-time re-lookup; the alias-removal case is pinned as a regression. The intermittent review-lane failure was traced to a locked-worktree window during checkout; the terminate-signal branch now waits out the registration window as the kill-signal branch already did, confirmed across three baseline and two post-fix runs at 114 of 114. Suites: verifier 98, router 135, registry 31, full CI-equivalent run green.
